chapter: Chapter 6 — Measuring What Matters: From Telemetry to Architecture Decisions
evidence: Figure 6.1 shows: “Workload metrics rps · token profile · concurrency”. Its caption states: “Figure-art note: the third printed entry in the workload box (concurrency) is an erratum in the figure art for the offered request rate λ; it is not a workload metric.”
issue: The figure still presents concurrency as a workload metric even though §6.1.1 defines concurrency as serving-side and derived, and the caption itself calls the figure entry an erratum. A reader who scans the figure receives the opposite classification from the prose.
fix_instruction: Regenerate Fig. 6.1 so the workload box contains offered request rate λ rather than concurrency, or remove the third entry entirely; make the figure match §6.1.1 and its caption.

chapter: Chapter 6 — Measuring What Matters: From Telemetry to Architecture Decisions
evidence: Figure 6.2 labels the threshold: “SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)”. Its caption states: “Figure-art note: the in-figure blue threshold label reads SLO 2 s (TTFT budget) — an erratum in the figure art for the 2 s p95 TTFT ceiling. The line is the ceiling that the 1.2 s design budget relaxes to; it is not a second budget.”
issue: The figure art labels the 2 s line as a TTFT budget, contradicting the canonical 1.2 s design budget and the separate 2 s p95 TTFT ceiling. Although the caption flags the problem, the visual still creates a false second budget.
fix_instruction: Relabel the in-figure threshold as “p95 TTFT ceiling = 2 s” or “2 s p95 TTFT ceiling”; remove the phrase “TTFT budget” from the figure art and keep the figure, caption, and §6.3.1 terminology aligned.
